chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān asked him:

About a mamluk who is out with the riding animals, grazing, and he wishes to perform ʿumrah and then depart. He said: “If he performed ʿumrah in Dhū al-Qaʿdah, then it is good; but if it was in Dhū al-Ḥijjah, then nothing is suitable except hajj.”

key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكِ: a servant or owned person under another's authority

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing ʿumrah in Dhū al-Qaʿdah versus Dhū al-Ḥijjah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the timing of ʿumrah for a servant occupied with grazing animals. It distinguishes between performing ʿumrah in Dhū al-Qaʿdah, which is acceptable, and in Dhū al-Ḥijjah, when the proper rite is hajj instead.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2942 - Abdullah ibn Sinan asked Imam (as) about a servant who is out grazing animals and agrees to perform Umrah and then leave.
Imam (as) said: "If he performed Umrah in Dhu al-Qa'dah, it is good. But if it is in Dhu al-Hijjah, then it is not suitable except for Hajj."
